findings.title: Initial actual precheck bypasses durable permanent halt
findings.expected: Authorized frozen-plan prelaunch validation failure persists a permanent zero-guest halt, old8 untouched; restored input cannot resume that successor
findings.actual: PredecessorIdentity from actual check/plan/transition propagates before guarded persistence, zero guests and no halt record
findings.requested_change: Durably bind authorized early validation/setup failures to exact frozen plan/transition; test actual run entry with unpatched check and retry-after-restoration. Preserve unauthorized no-authority behavior, old8 and max12.
